senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; אצל or נצל, cmp. צלע)the joint which touches the rib, elbow (with or without יד).
units: Arakh. 19ᵇ עד הא׳ up to the elbow.—Pl אַצִּילִים, constr. אַצִּילֵי.

<cite ref="Zevachim 19a:1">Zeb. 19ᵃ</cite> top <he>כנגד א׳ וכ׳</he> corresponding to the elbows (where the elbow in natural position touches the body). Y. Yoma V, 42ᵇ bot.; a. fr.—(Chald.) <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 8">Lev. R. s. 8</cite>, beg. <he>ודין אצילים פריך</he> some ed. (read <he>אצילֵיה</he>) and the other has his elbow (arm) broken.
